inputs.note: Public feed, no auth; fetched live 2026-11-27 (98 servers) and re-fetched same day (95 servers). Complete catalogs are never committed; only the 3-row synthetic fixture in tests/fixtures/.
9 raw 401 responses, no credentials inside; kept in the batch work dir, not in Git.

limitations: Own VPS catalog (9 types) BLOCKED: HTTP 401 without a Firebase App Check token; no token, broker or key invented. Needs a real token from a phone running the app.
No real .st file sample exists; .st verification is synthetic round-trip only (14/14) with realistic payloads from the app data models.
VPNGate feed is live volunteer data: server count varies daily (98 -> 95 on same-day re-run) and rows may carry '-' for unmeasured Ping.
Hysteria/Xray live configs only exist in the blocked VPS catalog; not verifiable until it unlocks.
The repo C0 .st decoder (decoders/Python/sentinel.py) fails all password-protected .st files (uses passwordHash as the data key); this patch overrides it via C8. The C0 matrix itself is untouched.
manual_steps: To unlock the VPS catalog: on a real phone running Sentinel Tunnel 4.0.0, obtain a Firebase App Check token (Play Integrity; certificate pinning blocks proxy interception, so copy the token from the device) and run the analyst catalog script with --appcheck-token <token>. No other manual step is needed for the VPNGate remote or .st files.
network_requirements: VPNGate feed: public HTTPS GET, no auth. VPS v2 API: signed requests + Firebase App Check token (unavailable in this environment).
rights/authorization_note: APK supplied by the owner for lote 15 analysis; integration authorized by the owner 2026-11-27. No secrets, APK bytes, complete catalogs or real credentials are stored in this dossier.
